component.name: 40 Winks PC Port
component.summary: Build and play 40 Winks from your own ROM

description.p: A self-building native Linux port of 40 Winks. On first launch it verifies a user-supplied ROM, generates the CPU translation locally, builds the playable runtime, and starts the game.
No ROM, extracted game asset, or generated game program is included in the downloadable AppImage.
Adds measurable first-build progress and a playable-build destination chooser.
First self-building AppImage with automatic local recompilation and launch.
